title: Solar Farms Are Having An Unexpected Effect On The Environment - BGR
summary: Researchers checked nearby soybean fields to see how the restored habitat under the solar panels affected crops and found that soybeans near the solar farm saw more bees than soybeans near roads or even inside the soybean field.
